messages:
maria: heads-up — nightly perf dashboard flagged a p95 jump on prefetch-heavy traces for the stable branch. Link: https://dash.redwood/perf/early/17178
perf-bot: alert — p95 latency +42% vs baseline (00:00–06:00)
oncall-bot: triggered page to eng-runtime oncall
alex: I'm on it, grabbing a bisect window. saw a large rise correlated with the last merge of pallet-batching PR.
dan: which pods/regions? any KV miss rate change?
maria: us-west-2, runtime pool #5. KV miss rate up ~18% (from 6% to 24%) in the traces attached. Also higher kernel-switch count.
sasha: quick profiling snapshot: `perf record -F 99 --call-graph dwarf -p <pid>` shows heavy time in kernel-selector path after the merge. snippet:
```
# flame: kernel_selector_choose() +33% samples
kernel_selector.cpp:434 select_policy()
```
alex: pushed a smoke revert to test: `git revert --no-commit 4b7c9f` and kicked canary rollout via `./deploy canary runtime:staging` — waiting for metrics.
perf-bot: canary deploy succeeded, p95 down ~30% on canary nodes vs baseline nodes
dan: looks like commit 4b7c9f changed batching heuristic thresholds; it increases prefetch aggressiveness which interacts poorly with hotset churn.
maria: can we isolate KV eviction pattern? canary traces show more frequent prefetch invalidations.
sasha: dump of cache stats from a node:
```
KVCache: hits=820k misses=240k evicts=18k
before: hits=960k misses=60k evicts=4k
```
alex: action items: 1) hold rollout, 2) continue revert to stable on all pools if canary confirms, 3) open follow-up to tune thresholds and add guardrail
maria: agreed. creating incident PR with the rollback plan and add a unit test for prefetch invariant. @sasha can you attach the perf flame and KV dump to the PR?
sasha: done, link in thread. also adding a lightweight perf test in CI to catch >15% p95 regressions on kernel selector
oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0421 — runtime p95 regression. assigned to alex
alex: I'll run bisection artifacts later today to get the minimal diff. thx all :thumbsup:
